audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer named Talon's ultimate "Noxian Diplomacy" and called it a true-damage execute. Noxian Diplomacy is his Q — a 575-range leap-and-stab on 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s. His R is Shadow Assault (100/80/60s): a ring of blades plus invisibility and move speed, with the blades converging when he reappears. Nothing in his kit is an execute, and nothing in it deals true damage. The content also repeatedly calls his combo "Rake-Cutthroat"; Cutthroat is not an ability he has — the wall vault is Assassin's Path.
audit.why: Riot's text for R: "disperses a ring of blades and becomes Invisible... the blades converge on his location." Blade's End (P) is a bleed after three Wound stacks, described as heavy damage over time, not true damage. Calling a Q an ult and inventing an execute threshold makes a player play the lane around a threshold that does not exist.
audit.corrected: whys[4], spikes[1].text, early and mid rewritten around Shadow Assault, Assassin's Path and Blade's End.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].side, [5].side and [6].side all read "Skill" while win[4]=Talon, win[5]=Talon, win[6]=Azir.
audit.why: The packet levelChart matches the content layer (Talon through first item, Azir at 2+ items) and the whys support it — his lethality spike lands before Nashor's does anything for you. The full-layer sides were the stale copy, and phases[4].why/[5].why described Azir winning stages the other layer gives to Talon.
audit.corrected: Sides aligned to Talon/Talon/Azir and the two contradicting whys rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.why: Spike order stands: his kill window is levels 3-6 into first-item lethality; yours is Nashor's then Rabadon's, and Shadow Assault falling to 60s at rank 3 keeps his pick threat alive all game.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit, and it treated Assassin's Path as if it had a normal cooldown.
audit.why: Assassin's Path has 0 cooldown and 0 cost — the used terrain goes on the long cooldown, not the ability. That is why he can keep vaulting in and out from a different wall, and it is the one thing a player must understand to ward correctly. Rake is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s and is the real punishable cooldown.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now names Rake's number as the step-up window and states the terrain-cooldown quirk.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim, both under roam-related titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: Both titles are about shoving and pinging his roams; the bodies explained trading instead.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten around the free wall vault and roam tempo.

notes: The content layer carried a real fabrication, not just a template: Talon's ultimate was named "Noxian Diplomacy" (that is his Q) and described as a true-damage execute, which his kit does not contain anywhere. "Cutthroat" is also not one of his abilities. Both were repeated across whys[4], spikes[1].text, early and mid; all four are corrected above. phases[4..6].side were moved to match win[4..6], which already held the correct values on disk, so no paired content edit exists to propose — this closes three pre-existing cross-layer disagreements.
